decisions.why: every one of the 33 captured product names is a named clinical/departmental imaging IT module read from the company's own sitemap (Sectra VNA, Sectra Breast Imaging PACS RIS, Sectra Digital Pathology Solution, Sectra Cardiology Solution, Sectra IDS7, Sectra Image Exchange Portal, Sectra One Cloud/Cloud Storage, Sectra Reporting, Sectra DoseTrack, Sectra Education Portal, Sectra 3D Spine/Joint Replacement/Trauma planning systems, Sectra Amplifier Marketplace/Services, PowerScribe 360 End of Life Planning) — this is Sectra's entire business, PACS/VNA/reporting software for radiology, pathology and cardiology, matching the digital:sw description ('clinical and departmental software systems (imaging, oncology, laboratory and asset-tracking)') exactly. One item, 'Sectra Table', is a named product whose own nature (hardware console vs. a software application) is not established by the name alone; kept in this single bucket with the rest rather than invented into a second division, since the sitemap carries no division structure to split on. Sectra is a company on this framework's own awarded-supplier list (Digital Diagnostic Solutions).
